title: Sterivex Water Filter eDNA Extraction Protocol
author: NEOF - NERC Environmental Omics Facility VF
materials: While waiting, pipette out sufficient AE buffer (50 µl x sample) into 1.5 or 2ml tubes and place in the thermomixer. This will be used in a later step.

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Tools
steps.instruction: Clean the work area with 10% bleach. Prepare one beaker with 50% bleach solution and one with ddH2O, ensuring beakers are autoclaved or disposable sterile containers are used.

steps.title: Sterilize Extraction Tools
steps.instruction: Decontaminate the tools used for filter extraction.

substeps.instruction: Place tweezers and scalpel in 50% bleach for 1 min, rinse in DNase-free ddH2O, and dry with sterile tissue paper.
Clean the pipe cutter with 10% bleach, rinse with DNase-free ddH2O, and dry with tissue paper.

steps.title: Extract Filter Paper from Unit
steps.instruction: Physically remove the filter paper from the Sterivex unit.

substeps.instruction: Crack open the filter unit on the outlet end using the pipe cutter.
Cut longitudinally along the filter and around the filter paper using the scalpel.
Remove the filter paper from the plastic unit with tweezers.
Place filter paper onto a petri-dish, cut into small parts, and transfer these into a 2 ml microfuge tube.

steps.title: Clean Tools Between Samples
steps.instruction: Reset the workspace and tools before processing the next sample in the batch.

substeps.instruction: Place tweezers and scalpel in 50% bleach.
Clean the pipe cutter and bench with 10% bleach.

steps.title: Lysis and Initial Incubation
steps.instruction: Perform the first stage of lysis on the filter material.

substeps.instruction: Add 450 µl Buffer ATL and 25 µl Proteinase K to each microfuge tube.
Use a filter tip to push all filter material down to ensure it is fully immersed in the liquid.
Vortex thoroughly and ensure the filter remains fully submerged.
Incubate overnight at 56°C in a thermomixer at 900rpm.

steps.title: Prepare for Secondary Processing
steps.instruction: Refresh the decontamination area and tools.

substeps.instruction: Clean the area and centrifuge with 10% bleach.
Remake the 50% bleach solution and ddH2O beakers.
Place tweezers in 50% bleach for 1 minute, rinse with ddH2O, and dry with tissue paper.

steps.title: Filter Material Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the lysis solution from the remaining filter paper.

substeps.instruction: Vortex each microfuge tube for 15 seconds.
Pipette as much solution as possible into a new 2 ml microfuge tube.
Transfer the remaining filter paper into a Qiashredder spin column using tweezers (clean tweezers with 50% bleach and ddH2O between samples).
Spin down original microfuge tubes and pipette any remaining lysis solution into the 2ml tube.
Centrifuge Qiashredder spin columns at 11,000rpm for 2 minutes.
Combine the liquid from the Qiashredder collection tube with the solution in the 2ml tube.
Dispose of the Qiashredder and empty lysis microfuge tubes.

steps.title: Secondary Lysis and Precipitation
steps.instruction: Complete the lysis and prepare the DNA for binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl Buffer AL to the 2ml microfuge tubes and vortex immediately.
Incubate at 56°C for 10 minutes in a thermomixer at 900rpm.
Remove samples from the heatblock and add 500 µl 100% ethanol (analytical reagent grade), then vortex immediately.

steps.title: DNA Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA using DNeasy spin columns.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µl of the solution to a DNeasy spin column and centrifuge at 8000rpm for 1 minute; repeat with a new collection tube until all solution has passed through.
Add 500 µl Buffer AW1 to the spin column and centrifuge at 8000rpm for 1 minute.
Place the spin column in a new collection tube, add 500 µl Buffer AW2, and centrifuge at 11,000rpm for 3 minutes.

steps.title: DNA Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA and store the samples.

substeps.instruction: Place spin columns into 1.5 ml tubes labeled with sample name and date.
Elute DNA with 50 µl Buffer AE (preheated to 56°C).
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then centrifuge at 8000rpm for 1 minute.
Discard the DNeasy spin column.
Freeze the 1.5 ml tube at -20°C (short-term) or -70°C (long-term).
Place the eluate from the 1.5ml tube back onto the spin column and centrifuge again at 8000rpm for 1 minute.
